contributions.detail: 8 rows sum to 2,698.35 = the schedule's printed TOTAL. Exactly one of them is at or under $50 (10.63), and 2,698.35 - 10.63 = 2,687.72 = cover line 1 in BOTH the THIS and CUMULATIVE columns (the LAST column is a slashed-zero, so this is the first report of the cycle and the scopes coincide); the 10.63 row alone is cover line 2. Reconciled against line 1 only, per the sub-$50 rule. NOTE the filer first wrote 2,698.35 on line 1 (both the THIS and CUMULATIVE cells), scribbled it out, and wrote 2,687.72 above it - the correction is what makes line 1 the over-$50 figure; both the struck and the standing values are legible and are reported here.

Cross-check by eye on the name column: p6 shows 9 inked name rows, one of them struck out with no amount - 8 names to 8 amounts, so the field-shift screen passes.

gates.balance_chain: Per report: both close exactly (see recon_by_report). CROSS-FILING CHAIN RUN (two filings by one filer in this PDF): report 2's CUMULATIVE column (2,687.72 / 10.63 / 2,698.35 / 0) does NOT equal report 1's TOTALS-FROM-LAST-REPORT column (96.88 / 0 / 96.88 / 0). The two are not comparable as a chain: report 2 closes the 2022 election cycle at a zero balance in June 2022, and report 1 is the January 2023 filing for the period 10-01-2022 to 12-31-2022 with its own small 96.88 in and 96.88 out. Either an intervening filing exists that is not stapled here, or the filer restarted the cumulative after the election - the document does not say which, and no figure was synthesised to bridge them.

notes: BUNDLE of 2 reports, out of chronological order: the PDF opens with the 2023-01-05 filing (period 10-01-2022 to 12-31-2022, RECEIVED JAN 05 2023) and then the 2022-06-21 filing (period Jan 1 2022 to June 21 2022, RECEIVED JUN 21 2022). n_reports_in_pdf 2 agrees with the chunk file. Both are Generation 2 (WASHINGTON COUNTY CANDIDATE FINANCIAL CAMPAIGN REPORT, Washington County Code 1-7-1) with the boxed grid and a printed footer TOTAL on each schedule. index.csv says candidate 'Victor Moses Iverson', office 'Commission Seat B' - the forms agree: 'Full Name of Candidate Victor Moses Iverson'; report 1's Office line reads 'Washington County Commission Seat B' and report 2's reads 'County Commission Seat B'. Representative District: 'County wide' (report 1) / 'all areas of county' (report 2). EVERY contribution on report 2 is the candidate's own money (self-funding), entered once by name and then as a circled '(Same)' ditto in both the name and address columns. The In Kind? column exists on this form generation and is answered 'no' on all 8 rows, so in_kind is false throughout - a 'no', not an inference. Candidate home street address, ZIP and both phone numbers appear in the clear on both covers and were discarded at read time; the donor address column carries the same street address and ZIP and only the city was retained. Page rot 270; poppler renders all six pages upright portrait 1700x2200.
